name: git
description: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes (list or tree view, unified or side-by-side diff), stage/unstage/discard files, pull, stash, commit, and preview modified images side-by-side (old vs new), pull, stash, commit, and generate AI commit messages with a custom prompt.

description_i18n.en: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes with list/tree views and unified/side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard files, pull, stash (push/pop/apply), write and run commits, and generate AI commit messages with an optional custom prompt.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Git 工作台侧栏面板：以列表/树结构查看暂存区与工作区修改（统一/并排 diff），支持暂存、取消暂存、撤销、全部暂存/取消，图片文件旧版/新版并排预览比对，拉取远程更新，存储/恢复/应用 stash，一键提交，并可附加自定义提示词用 AI 生成提交信息；面板自动跟踪外部文件改动。
